tools.name: Fetch Price
tools.description:
Fetch real-time cryptocurrency price from CoinGecko API.
        
Returns current price, 24h change, and trading volume for any supported cryptocurrency.

**Use Case:** Get instant price data before executing trades or analyzing positions.

**Cost:** $0.005 USD per call (cheapest tier - high frequency allowed)

**Example Response:**
{
  "symbol": "bitcoin",
  "price_usd": 67842.50,
  "change_24h": 2.34,
  "volume_24h": 28500000000,
  "timestamp": "2026-08-24T15:30:00Z"
}

tools.name: Analyze Volatility
tools.description:
Analyze price volatility using statistical Z-score anomaly detection.
        
Calculates standard deviations from mean price to detect anomalous movements.
Configurable thresholds and time windows for customized analysis.

**Use Case:** Identify unusual price movements before they become obvious trends.

**Cost:** $0.02 USD per call

**Parameters:**
- `symbol`: Crypto symbol to analyze
- `window_minutes`: Historical window (1-1440 min, default: 60)
- `z_threshold`: Std dev threshold for anomalies (0.1-5.0σ, default: 2.0)

**Alert Levels:** NORMAL → MODERATE → HIGH → CRITICAL

tools.name: Aggregate Sentiment
tools.description:
Aggregate social media sentiment across multiple sources.
        
Combines Twitter/X, Reddit, and other platforms into unified sentiment scores (-1.0 to +1.0).
Detects momentum shifts and trend changes in community opinion.

**Use Case:** Gauge market psychology before major moves.

**Cost:** $0.01 USD per call

**Sources:** twitter, reddit, telegram, news

**Output:** Overall sentiment category (bullish/neutral/bearish) with breakdown by source.

tools.name: Calculate Risk Score
tools.description:
Calculate multi-factor risk assessment for cryptocurrencies.
        
Combines volatility, liquidity, market cap tier, and Bitcoin correlation into
a comprehensive risk score (0-1 scale) with actionable recommendations.

**Use Case:** Assess position sizing and stop-loss levels.

**Cost:** $0.03 USD per call

**Risk Levels:** LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | CRITICAL

**Factors Analyzed:**
- Volatility risk (40% weight)
- Liquidity risk (25% weight)
- Market cap tier (20% weight)
- BTC correlation (15% weight)

tools.name: Generate Market Report
tools.description:
Generate comprehensive market intelligence report.
        
Synthesizes price, volatility, sentiment, and risk data into actionable insights.
Perfect for daily briefings or strategic planning.

**Use Case:** End-of-day summary or pre-trade due diligence.

**Cost:** $0.15 USD per report

**Report Types:**
- daily: 24-hour overview
- weekly: 7-day trends  
- monthly: 30-day strategic analysis

**Includes:** Executive summary, key signals, actionable recommendations

tools.name: Geo Health
tools.description: Free diagnostic check returning live service uptime, supported AI crawler matrix, x402 payment configuration (Base USDC payTo and CDP facilitator readiness), and SSRF protection status. Call this or geo_pricing first before running paid live-site audits.

tools.name: Geo Pricing
tools.description: Free pricing manifest listing all ApexSEO GEO audit endpoints, Base Mainnet (eip155:8453) USDC prices ($0.01-$0.05), endpoint paths, and MCP Streamable HTTP connection details. Ideal sibling to geo_health before dispatching paid calls.

tools.name: Ai Crawler Audit
tools.description: Live-fetches a domain's /robots.txt, /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /sitemap.xml, and /.well-known/{x402,mcp,agent-card.json} files, returning a per-bot permission matrix (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Bingbot, Applebot-Extended, CCBot), AI-crawler readiness score (0-100), and ICE fixes. Use geo_page_audit for HTML/TTFB signals or schema_citation_check for JSON-LD validation.

tools.name: Geo Page Audit
tools.description: Performs a comprehensive live technical + Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO) audit of any URL: measures TTFB, redirect chain, X-Robots-Tag, meta robots, canonical/hreflang, compression & security headers, title/meta/OpenGraph, H1-H3 question-heading density, structured lists/tables, empty CSR-shell detection, image alt coverage, E-E-A-T trust signals, composite geoScore (0-100), and ApexSEO Elite ICE action plan. Pair with ai_crawler_audit for site-wide robots.txt/llms.txt or geo_competitor_compare for rival benchmarking.

tools.name: Schema Citation Check
tools.description: Extracts and validates all embedded application/ld+json blocks (including @graph trees) on a live page, flags syntax errors and missing AI-citation properties for Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, Product, Article, FAQPage, and WebPage entities, scores schema completeness (0-100), and outputs a ready-to-paste JSON-LD @graph patch customized from detected metadata.

tools.name: Geo Competitor Compare
tools.description: Runs parallel live page GEO audits and AI-crawler (robots.txt / llms.txt) checks across your targetUrl and 1-3 competitorUrls, computing exact win/loss deltas across geoScore, AI-crawler readiness, TTFB speed, schema depth, question headings, and llms.txt coverage, plus a ranked ICE counter-strategy roadmap.

tools.name: Query Minneapolis Compliance
tools.description: Fetches real-time City of Minneapolis housing code violations, active repair orders, and building permits for a street address. Costs 0.01 USDC (10000 units) on Base Mainnet (eip155:8453) via x402 EIP-3009.

tools.name: Query Ramsey Parcel Audit
tools.description: Queries Ramsey County Open GIS for parcel attributes, registered owner, property use class, and tax assessment valuation by PIN or street address. Costs 0.01 USDC (10000 units) on Base Mainnet (eip155:8453) via x402 EIP-3009.

tools.name: Evaluate X402 Credit
tools.description: Evaluates an x402 (Payment Required) call payload across 3 consensus nodes (Alpha, Beta, Gamma) and returns a credit score (0-1000) with GO/NO-GO recommendation.

tools.name: Agentmail Send

tools.name: Agentmail Inbox
tools.description: Reads recent AgentMail inbox messages or threat alerts.

tools.name: Swarm Health
tools.description: Checks 3-node swarm status, x402 v2 payment requirements, and configuration.

tools.name: X402.Agent Card
tools.description: Return the A2A Protocol v1.0 Agent ID Card and MCP server card. Optional target_id filters to a skill id, name, or tag.

tools.name: X402.Discover
tools.description: Discover paid HTTP APIs in the x402 Bazaar via the facilitator catalog. Call this first to find a resource URL, then x402.probe and x402.pay_and_fetch.

tools.name: X402.Probe
tools.description: Probe a URL for HTTP 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED terms using the x402 client SDK. Use before x402.pay_and_fetch to inspect price, network, and payTo without spending.

tools.name: X402.Pay And Fetch
tools.description: Pay USDC via x402 and fetch a protected HTTP resource in one call. Requires EVM_PRIVATE_KEY on this host; otherwise use x402.probe for a no-spend 402.

tools.name: X402.Build Seller
tools.description: Build seller-side x402 payment requirements for your own HTTP resource. Pass resource_url plus discovery_* fields to catalog the endpoint in Bazaar.

tools.name: X402.Verify
tools.description: Verify an x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE against PAYMENT-REQUIRED terms via the facilitator. Call after a buyer presents a signature and before releasing paid content.

tools.name: X402.Policy Check
tools.description: Offline buyer payment-policy check: decode a caller-supplied merchant PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and evaluate each accepts[] option against an explicit policy (networks, pay_to, assets, atomic amount, timeouts). Does not fetch merchant URLs or prove settlement on the inspected resource. Unpaid returns PaymentRequired for this server's separate analysis fee; pay via _meta['x402/payment']. Policy is consistency only, not proof.

tools.name: X402.Networks
tools.description: List supported settlement networks, facilitators, and x402 v2 header names. Call when choosing a preferred_network for x402.pay_and_fetch or x402.build_seller.

tools.name: Commerce.Pro Requirements
tools.description: Build x402 payment requirements to purchase the Pro quota tier. Next: pay those terms, then commerce.activate_pro with the signature.

tools.name: Commerce.Activate Pro
tools.description: Verify a Pro-tier x402 payment and unlock Pro quota limits for the agent. MCP-native: call unpaid for x402 requirements, retry with _meta x402/payment; or legacy PAYMENT-SIGNATURE after commerce.pro_requirements.

tools.name: Commerce.Credits Requirements
tools.description: Build x402 payment requirements to buy a pack of per-use MCP tool credits. Next: pay those terms, then commerce.purchase_credits with the signature.

tools.name: Commerce.Purchase Credits
tools.description: Verify an x402 payment and add per-use tool credits to the agent. MCP-native: unpaid call + _meta x402/payment retry; or legacy headers after commerce.credits_requirements.

tools.name: Swarm.Research
tools.description: Run the swarm agency: compose a research product from free inputs and list it for resale. Pass allow_paid_inputs=true only when buying upstream x402 services is intended.

tools.name: Swarm.Settle
tools.description: Verify and settle a buyer's x402 payment for a listed composite product and record revenue. Call with product_id plus PAYMENT-SIGNATURE after the buyer pays.

tools.name: Swarm.Revenue
tools.description: Get swarm composite economics: spend, composite sales, LTV:CAC, margins, per-source scores. total_revenue_usdc is swarm listings only; storefront.revenue_usdc is the full settled ledger. Call after swarm.research or swarm.settle to inspect realized economics.

tools.name: Pulse.Base
tools.description: Get live Base Network Pulse: base fee, EIP-1559 projection, utilization, USD settlement cost, verdict. Call before settling on Base when you need a settle-now vs hold recommendation.

tools.name: Ops.Metrics
tools.description: Get host OS telemetry: CPU, memory, swap, disk, network, and an ok/warn/critical health verdict. Call to diagnose this MCP host; set include_processes=true for top memory processes.

tools.name: City.List
tools.description: List US cities with paid_url and free sample_url for property compliance. Start here — each paid lookup is $0.01 USDC and returns a normalized verdict (licensed / not_licensed / violations_open / …) plus source link, not raw portal JSON. Then city.sample (free shape), then city.check. Covers Minneapolis, Minnesota rental licensing (city_code mn) and other US cities.

tools.name: City.Sample
tools.description: Free fixed-address preview of paid property-check JSON: verdict, summary, schema. Use before city.check to validate parsing without spending $0.01 USDC.

tools.name: City.Check
tools.description: Is this US address licensed / flagged / showing open violations? One city.check ($0.01 USDC, x402 on Base) returns verdict, summary, dates, and source_url — skip querying city open-data portals yourself. Unpaid → PaymentRequired; pay via _meta['x402/payment']. Prefer city.sample first.

tools.name: A2a.Resolve Card
tools.description: Discover and inspect an external Agent-to-Agent (A2A) node by domain or URL. Fetches .well-known/agent-card.json, validates protocol compatibility, checks for a2a-x402 and AP2 payment extensions, and extracts callable skills with pricing.

tools.name: Oracle Health
tools.description: Check x402 Oracle server health, configured Base payTo posture, facilitator mode (demo or live), and seller-key safety flags. Free and read-only; requires no arguments or payment header. Use this before calling paid consult tools to verify availability; use oracle_pricing to inspect USD fees.

tools.name: Oracle Pricing
tools.description: List all free and paid x402 Oracle endpoints, current clamped USDC prices on Base, max price ceiling, and connection instructions. Free and read-only; takes no parameters. Call this instead of oracle_health when selecting a paid consult tool and budgeting payment amount.

tools.name: Oracle Ask
tools.description: Ask a general architectural or ranking question about x402 micropayments, MCP monetization, A2A agent cards, or CDP Bazaar discovery ($0.10 USDC on Base). Unpaid calls return an HTTP 402 challenge envelope (`isError: true`); retry with `_meta['x402/payment']`. Use oracle_diagnose_402 instead to inspect a raw PAYMENT-REQUIRED header.

tools.name: Oracle Diagnose 402
tools.description: Decode and audit an HTTP 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 or JSON) for accepts[], Base USDC terms, extensions.bazaar schema validity, and resource.url alignment ($0.50 USDC on Base). Unpaid calls return 402 terms. Use this instead of oracle_review_mcp when debugging a single 402 payload before facilitator settlement.

tools.name: Oracle Review Mcp
tools.description: Audit a paid MCP server architecture for x402 payment wrapping, declareDiscoveryExtension metadata, free health tooling, Streamable HTTP compliance, and seller-key isolation ($3.00 USDC on Base). Unpaid calls return 402 terms. Use oracle_bazaar_rewrite for listing copy or oracle_diagnose_402 for single header checks.

tools.name: Oracle Bazaar Rewrite
tools.description: Generate SEO-optimized CDP Bazaar metadata (serviceName <=32 chars, description <=500 chars, <=5 tags) front-loaded with buyer search phrases and first-index freeze warnings ($1.50 USDC on Base). Unpaid calls return 402 terms. Use this before settling a new SKU; for broader launch diffs use complete_oracle_task.

tools.name: Complete Oracle Task
tools.description: Execute a high-depth outcome planning task delivering typed diffs, security constraints, operator handoff checklists, and ship verification steps for an x402 production launch goal ($10.00 USDC on Base). Unpaid calls return 402 terms. Use for end-to-end delivery plans; use oracle_ask ($0.10) for shorter Q&A.
